name: BBPoW (Bitcoin-Backed PoW research)
author: DogeGo
description: EXPERIMENTAL testnet-only: verify Bitcoin SHA-256 commitments as a Dogecoin security signal (BBPoW/CAuxPoW). Not AuxPoW; not a soft fork. Off-L1 only. Consensus adoption would be a Dogecoin hard fork (can reuse AuxPoW wire, not Scrypt validation).

rpc.name: info
rpc.help: BBPoW research status + dual-lane difficulty sketch + AuxPoW comparison.

rpc.name: compare
rpc.help: Why this is not AuxPoW; hard-fork note; naming (BBPoW / CAuxPoW).

rpc.name: dualmodel
rpc.help: Independent Scrypt vs SHA-256 difficulty research model snapshot.

rpc.name: buildcommitment
rpc.help: Build BBPoW||doge_block_hash commitment hex for a Bitcoin coinbase. Param: [doge_block_hash_hex].

rpc.name: checkheader
rpc.help: Verify SHA-256 PoW on an 80-byte Bitcoin header hex. Param: [header_hex].

rpc.name: verifyproof
rpc.help: Validate a research BitcoinProof JSON (header + coinbase + merkle). Param: [proof_object].

rpc.name: recordlane
rpc.help: Record a research block on a lane. Params: ["scrypt_auxpow"|"sha256_bbpow", bits?].
